apps.name: Conway's Game of Life
apps.description: Cellular automaton on the 16x16 Stellar Unicorn. Draw a pattern, or seed it at random, then watch it run.

apps.name: Image Shower
apps.description: Pick an image file and display it on the Stellar Unicorn. Handles PNG, JPEG, BMP, WebP and animated GIF.

apps.name: Panel Self-Test
apps.description: Check the link to the Stellar Unicorn one layer at a time, then light the panel up. Run this first when the panel stays dark.
